Historical exposure-lock note — November 8, 2024

- Final actual exposure count: 13.
- Further Q4 exposures: none may be added; the exposure phase is closed while outcome windows mature.
- Final observation window: 45 days, starting November 8, 2024, the date of the final exposure.

This note records the exposure lock and observation-window boundary only. Keep it separate from later outcome analysis; it contains no outcome results.
